title: chore: defect hunt (11-03 #11): file 2-4 evidence-backed bug rows from the claim-eligibility entry points, the daemon read/query tools, and the sweep and reload paths
description:
Filed by the governor at 20:23Z on 2026-11-03. It runs in parallel with hunt #10 (task-49a2c07f), which architect-1dd28c7c claimed at 20:15Z, on disjoint lanes.

WHY. At filing time 6 coders are idle and only 1 WORKING row is being coded (CQ-M07n3). The hunt #9 rows cleared fast: 9f34bac5 was planned, coded and QA'd in about 7 minutes. PLANNING holds only 3962d9a0 and hunt #10.

LANE. Search in this order of preference:
1. The claim-eligibility entry points: packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/{claimNextTask,getNextTask,waitForTask}.ts and src/util/{claimEligibility,claimableStatuses}.ts. Look for a rule (status, role, dependsOn readiness, finalizing hold, BLOCKED handling, priority/order, epic filter, team membership) that one entry point applies and a sibling skips. Examples: get_next_task offering a row claim_next_task would refuse, or wait_for_task waking for a row nobody may claim. Cite both lines and show the difference with a call.
2. The daemon read/query tools: listMetrics.ts (with src/util/metrics.ts; it has no test file of its own), getActivityLog.ts (with src/state/activityLog.ts, src/util/reverseReader.ts and src/util/LogRotator.ts), searchTasks.ts, listTasks.ts, getPendingQuestions.ts and listWorkers.ts. Look for a filter, limit or pagination cap, ARCHIVED rule, or documented parameter that one query tool honours and a sibling ignores, or that docs/MCP_SERVER.md documents and the code does not implement (or the reverse).
3. The sweep and reload paths: src/state/sweeps.ts, src/state/FileWatcher.ts, src/state/persistence.ts, src/util/atomicWrite.ts and src/state/massDeletionHeal.ts. Look for an alert that contradicts its documented rule (the governor role doc's blockedAt-age alert and stale-worker watcher), a reload that drops or resets a field, or an alert that double-fires or never fires. Cite today's log lines where they exist.

At filing time that is scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1}, scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.{sh,ps1}, scripts/tests/postflight-fake-proxy.js, scripts/tests/parity-check.{sh,ps1}, scripts/moe-account-lease.mjs and its test, setTaskStatus.ts and its test (629ddc99, in REVIEW), releaseTask.ts, releaseResource.ts and src/util/claimGuards.ts (0adea941, in REVIEW), and joinTeam.ts, teamStore.ts and joinTeam.deadMembers.test.ts (3962d9a0, being planned).

- TURBO auto-approve's "WORKING by unknown" line; the JetBrains board fingerprint omitting needsHumanReview; isEpicFinal's max-order fallback (msg-bbf4f109); a7d02ec3.
- Held items: hunt #7 (b), the wrapper's UNKNOWN-status message; hunt #8, the using-git-worktrees skill text and chat_send's whitespace-only content; hunt #9 (b), EpicDetailDialog's ARCHIVED through /ws UPDATE_EPIC.
- This checkout's local .serena/project.yml ignoring docs/.

EVIDENCE BAR. Same as hunts #2-#10. Work only from real evidence:
- A repro on HEAD 677d051a or later: the command and its observed output, run in a git archive or clone snapshot outside the shared checkout. Global rail: never build or test in place.
- A failure line from today's logs: the file and the timestamp.
- For a family or gate gap: the sibling file:line that applies the check, the member file:line that skips it, and a test or call that shows the difference.
No speculative or style-only findings.

OUTPUT AND HOW TO FINISH. This row produces no code and no plan, so do not call moe.submit_plan.
1. File each finding with moe.create_task in the epic that owns the code. Use status PLANNING, and add no dependsOn unless a real logic edge exists (in worktree mode a shared file gets a placement note, not an edge). Each row gets a problem statement, the evidence, a fix direction and 2-3 checkable DoD items. Prefer rows QA can check with one vitest file.
2. Post the ids, or "nothing real", in #governors and mention the governor (governor-e6b40560).
3. Archive this row yourself with moe.archive_task.
definitionOfDone: 2-4 new bug rows are filed in the epics that own the code, or "nothing real" is posted. Either way the outcome is posted in #governors.
Every filed row cites its evidence: a repro on HEAD 677d051a or later run outside the shared checkout, a failure line from today's logs, or a sibling/member (or doc/code) file:line pair.
No filed row targets a file an open row holds (per lanes.js at hunt time) or duplicates a hunt #10 lane. The holder archives this row once the ids are posted.
